title: MysticHorror
description: MysticHorror is a plugin aimed at trolling.
body:
🔮 MysticHorror | Horror effects for your server

**Supported: Paper 1.17.х  
Category: Fun / Immersive**

---

👻 About

**MysticHorror** adds random scary events to your Minecraft server — sounds, visual effects, camera shake. Your players will jump at unexpected screamers, whispers, demon laughs, and other eerie phenomena.

No resource packs required — everything works with vanilla Minecraft sounds.

---

 ✨ Features

🎭 Local Events (single player)
Events happen **individually** for each player. Chance, interval, and cooldown are fully configurable.

| Event | Effect |
|-------|--------|
| WHISPER | Mysterious whisper |
| SCREAMER | Loud scream + camera shake |
| DEMON | Demon laugh + blindness (2 sec) |
| DOOR_CREAK | Creaking door sound |
| HEARTBEAT | Fast heartbeat (5 beats) |
| STATIC | Radio static + slowness (2 sec) |
| CHILD_LAUGH | Child's laugh |
| JUMPSCARE | Sudden scream + nausea (3 sec) + camera shake |

 
🌍 Global Events (all players)
Events affect **everyone online** at the same time.

| Event | Effect |
|-------|--------|
| **THUNDER_CRASH** | Thunder strike (loud sound) |
| **EARTHQUAKE** | Rumbling ground sound |
| **BANSHEE_SCREAM** | Banshee scream |
| **SHADOW_PASS** | Passing shadow sound |

 📋 Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| `/mh reload` | Reload configuration | `mystichorror.admin` |
| `/mh list` | List all events | `mystichorror.admin` |
| `/mh trigger local <player> <event>` | Trigger local event | `mystichorror.admin` |
| `/mh trigger global <event>` | Trigger global event | `mystichorror.admin` |

**Examples:**
_bash
/mh trigger local Notch jumpscare
/mh trigger global thunder_crash_


🔧 Configuration (config.yml)

```
yaml
# Local events (single player)
local-events:
  enabled: true
  interval: 10
  chance-min: 5
  chance-max: 15
  cooldown-min: 60
  cooldown-max: 180

# Global events (all players)
global-events:
  enabled: true
  interval: 30
  chance-min: 2
  chance-max: 8
  cooldown-min: 180
  cooldown-max: 300
```

🚀 Installation
Download MysticHorror

Place it into your server's plugins folder (Paper server required)

Restart the server

Adjust config.yml to your preferences

Grant 
```
mystichorror.admin
```
 permission to trusted players or leave it for OPs only

🎯 Permissions
Permission	Description
mystichorror.admin	Access to all commands (default: operators)
💡 Tips
For Halloween events — temporarily increase chance to 50–70% for maximum scares

For regular gameplay — keep 5–15% (won't get annoying)

The /mh list command can be given to trusted players via LuckPerms
